description: Land Acquisition - Delana, Kuliyapitiya - West D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Amendment to the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1719/37 of 19.08.2011, Imbulpe D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, extents, boundaries, and claimant information. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions, property descriptions, and related administrative procedures for land transfer to the government.
